task: Fix intermittent 401 errors in payment-svc following vault key rotation yesterday. Candidate pool drawn from a 180-entry store spanning 12 projects.

candidate_memories.content: 401 errors in payment-svc began at 14:02 UTC, two hours after vault key rotation completed at 12:00 UTC.
payment-svc auth middleware reads signing keys from vault:/secret/payment/jwt; falls back to ENV on vault unreachable.
Token cache TTL in auth_middleware.py is 60 s; stale keys can persist up to 60 s after rotation.
After vault key rotation, restart payment-svc auth workers to flush the in-process key cache immediately.
New rate limiter deployed at 09:30 UTC reduced API p99 latency by 12 ms on average.
user-svc login was migrated from basic auth to OAuth 2.0 PKCE last quarter; no impact on payment-svc.
payment-svc used ENV-only keys before vault integration in Q1 2024; those keys were rotated at that time.
